title: Square 1:1 reframe of the motion promo
caption: The silent 16:9 motion promo reframed to a 1080x1080 square for feed posts. The fit strategy keeps the full-width headline and chart, and the cream padding matches the promo's own background.
prompt: Make a 1:1 square version of ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 for an Instagram and LinkedIn feed post. Use the first 9.6 seconds (headline, button, service card and the leads chart). The headline and the chart are wider than a square, so fit the frame rather than crop it, and pad with the Magnifito cream #f0eadf so the bands blend into the background. Output 1080x1080.
credits: Video: 06-motion-graphics from this showcase (Geist and Geist Mono fonts by Vercel, SIL OFL 1.1; motion engine adapted from Barty-Bart/motion-graphics, MIT)
